title: A high order accurate and energy stable continuous Galerkin framework on summation-by-parts form for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations
summary: This paper presents a high-order accurate Continuous Galerkin Finite Element Method (CGFEM) for solving the initial boundary value problems governed by the Incompressible Navier-Stokes (INS) equations. We discretize the INS equations using the CGFEM approach in Summation-By-Parts (SBP) form. Lagrange polynomials of up to 4th order are employed. The boundary conditions are imposed weakly using the Simultaneous Approximation Term (SAT) technique, which accommodates discontinuous boundary data without special treatment.
